messages:
Marco (Enterprise Sales): @billing-team — heads up, BigBridge says the enterprise promo from their PO never applied. PO BB-2024-889 references a one-time $50k credit. They were billed for April. Can we manually apply?
Aisha (Customer Success): Adding context: account `bigbridge-inc`, invoice 98765 charged $12,300 on 2026-03-15. Sales listed promo code `BB-ENT-50K` in PO notes. Customer tried to attach via our console/API and it either returned an error or silently didn't affect billing.
Marco (Enterprise Sales): Error they saw when trying to attach: `{"error":"promo_not_found"}`. Sales already emailed the PO PDF to the customer success inbox. Need either manual credit or reversal + credit note. Customer is unhappy.
Billing Bot: Ticket created: CS-1082. Kicking off preliminary checks.
Prashant (FinOps): Can you paste the PO note text and the billing contact? Also confirm environment (hosted vs dedicated). If hosted, we can retroactively issue credits.
Aisha (Customer Success): PO note text: "Apply enterprise promotional credit: $50,000 one-time, use in FY24, credit code BB-ENT-50K". Billing contact: billing@bigbridge.com. Environment: hosted (Redwood API).
Prashant (FinOps): Doing invoice lookup now. Quick log snippet: 
``` 
2026-03-15T10:02:11Z invoice 98765 created amount 12300 credits 0 promo_code null
2026-03-15T10:03:12Z payment_capture success
``` 
Looks like the promo was null at billing time. We'll need to create a manual credit note / journal adjustment.
Marco (Enterprise Sales): Customer is escalating to legal if not resolved quickly. They want either an immediate refund for the charge or a clear ledger credit and an explanation. Also request that the PO reference be added to the account metadata so future billings pick this up automatically.
Prashant (FinOps): I can create a manual credit of $50,000 and apply it to the account. For invoice 98765 we'll either apply the credit and refund the overpayment or leave it as account credit per customer preference. Which does BigBridge want?
Aisha (Customer Success): They want an immediate refund to the card for the $12,300. For audit trail please include PO ref `BB-2024-889` and note "manual enterprise promo applied per sales PO". Also please attach the emailed PO PDF to the billing ticket.
Prashant (FinOps): Will do. I'll create credit note CN-2026-442, apply the credit to the account, and initiate a refund for $12,300. ETA 2-3 business days for the refund to hit the card. Tagging @devon to look into the promo ingestion path so this doesn't recur.
Devon (SRE): I'll take a look at promo-service and the ingestion pipeline. Quick initial check shows a race where promo metadata wasn't linked to the customer record before invoice generation in a small percentage of cases. Opening OPS ticket to patch and add a retry.
Marco (Enterprise Sales): :thumbsup: Thanks — please update this thread with the billing/refund ticket numbers so I can escalate internally to the customer.
Billing Bot: Tickets opened: CS-1082 (customer escalation), BILL-4027 (manual credit/credit note), OPS-2211 (promo ingestion failure). Please monitor and update when actions complete.
Prashant (FinOps): Follow-ups: I'll attach PO PDF to BILL-4027, create CN-2026-442, and post the refund confirmation here once processed.
Aisha (Customer Success): Noted. I'll inform BigBridge that we have initiated the credit/refund and share the expected ETA. Keeping thread open for updates.
